manifeste.body: Every MAWUYA bag is designed to last. To move through seasons without following any. To become, with time, the object one entrusts to those who come after.

atelier_section.title: Imagined, drawn and crafted in Abidjan.
atelier_section.body: Our Deux Plateaux atelier is the heart of the house. Each piece is imagined by Ama Diallo, founder, then entrusted to our partner craftspeople. Twenty bags leave each month. Not one more.

maison.intro: In 2021, in an Abidjan apartment, a young woman decorates a black clutch with cowries and Baoulé weights. She knows nothing about leather goods. She does not yet know that this gesture will become a house.
